milestone.label: v0.16 - Supabase auth + Stripe subscriptions + live TICA data pipeline

items: Judge-panel coverage polish: intl coverage grows as the daily cron converges; re-check cadence for clubs that post panels late
Multi-user ownership model (docs/AUTH-OWNERSHIP-DESIGN.md): MERGED co-ownership (shared writes both see), email invite notification, reg-number join requests + certificate verification
Auth polish: email OTP code / verification edge cases

Security (docs/SECURITY.md): sprint 2026-06-30..07-02 (v0.17.2-0.17.10). DONE: CSP+headers (run_worker_first), rate limits, audit log, prototype-pollution guard, shared-cat payload sanitization, seed-share owner-check, DB advisor lockdown (migration 0006), judge-rating anti-ballot-stuffing, supabase-js confirmed latest, leaked webhook revoked, rotation runbook. **P1-7 DONE + verified live: per-user state migrated to Postgres user_state with RLS (migration 0007); dual-write KV+PG, STATE_READ=pg flag + KV fallback/lazy-backfill; RLS isolation proven (own-row-only/anon-denied); view-as+sharing stay on KV; cost-neutral (free tier) + cron keep-warm.** **Turnstile widget CREATED + site key wired + deployed (v0.17.12, 2026-07-02): managed-mode widget for ring.yesandeverything.com, TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY var live, /api/config serves it, CSP opens challenges.cloudflare.com, login renders widget + passes captchaToken; verified turnstile.render() accepts the key on the live hostname.** **Turnstile ENFORCING (2026-07-03): Kane pasted the secret into Supabase CAPTCHA; verified live — OTP without captcha_token now returns captcha_failed.** OPEN: full relational cats/shows normalization (optional product-scale), move view-as/sharing reads to DEFINER RPCs. Ring Resources Bot webhook recreated 2026-07-06 (real URL on disk, audit digests posting again).

barRaise.topFinding: Ring is live and working for its one real user plus the TICA public, and health moved 77 to 73, not a collapse but a real slide worth naming. Two things make this run needs-attention rather than in-progress: mergeStates() in public/app.js still replaces whole arrays like decisionsList and myVotes on every boot instead of merging them, so a second device or a reboot can silently drop a newer edit (pwa-sync-01, escalated from MEDIUM to HIGH this run), and community judge ratings still live only in KV with no backup of any kind (data-integrity-02, open 4 runs). A fresh HIGH also landed on the public site itself: public/index.html's title, social-meta tags, and footer have carried live em dashes since the very first commit, invisible to every voice audit because .project-context.json's voice_scope has never covered rendered HTML, only the markdown docs (ai-tell-concealment-01). Commit velocity over the last nine days went almost entirely into release-script hardening rather than the one open product decision (v1.0 freeze vs Phase-2 ownership scope), which is itself now flagged as a strategic finding.

actions.title: Log a caught pgStateWrite failure and retry once so the KV+Postgres state dual-write cannot drift silently.
Back up the KV-only community judge ratings to a Postgres mirror or a scheduled snapshot.
Commit a runnable single-cat-extraction leak test and an npm test script, or correct the SECURITY.md:47 claim that it is unit-tested.
Add console.error logging to every silent catch block in the TICA-scraping and billing handlers so a systemic break stops being invisible.
Add authenticated user-data export and delete endpoints plus a documented retention policy.
Add timestamp-aware conflict handling to mergeStates() so decisionsList, judgeStatus, myVotes, and catTargets union instead of getting replaced wholesale on sync.
Give schedulePush a retry-with-backoff path (or re-arm on next app-visible) and a subtle not-synced indicator instead of swallowing push failures.
Spend the next Ring session on the v1.0-freeze-vs-Phase-2-scope decision instead of further release-script hardening; nine days of commits have been tooling polish, not product work.
Stop paying a KV write on every rate-limit check and debounce/batch the state-autosave write path so free-tier KV write limits aren't the pricing ceiling.
Section public/app.js into documented layers matching the module list in PROJECT_SPEC.md.
Wire a persistent log sink (Discord post or Logpush/Analytics Engine) for cron and scraper failures instead of relying on the ephemeral live tail.
Have scheduled() write a lastCronRun/lastCronOk marker to KV and surface it in /api/health.
Publish a short privacy/terms page naming the data collected (email, TICA reg, Stripe status) and its retention behavior.
Move view-as and shared-cats reads onto SECURITY DEFINER RPCs to match the RLS-backed isolation already shipped for own-data reads.
Build the missing Ring Audit Bot / Ring Backlog Bot webhooks and posting steps, or remove them from CLAUDE.md's table so it matches what actually posts.
Parallelize the sequential per-grant KV reads in handleSharedCats with Promise.all.
Log a warning whenever the KV-backed rate limiter falls back to fail-open so a dead RATINGS binding is visible.
Bump the wrangler devDependency to the major actually in use, install locally, and commit a lockfile.
Apply AbortSignal.timeout to the Stripe, Supabase, Discord, and Resend fetches the way TICA fetches already do.
Wrap the Discord-notify step in release.ps1 in the same try/catch pattern as the dashboard and audit-digest steps so it degrades to a warning instead of aborting the release.
Add a release-time grep gate for em dashes and AI-tell vocabulary across every public_artifact_globs path.
Record the vendored supabase-js version and pull date in a header comment on public/vendor/supabase.js.
Cache or JWKS-verify Supabase tokens so verifyUser stops paying a live round-trip on every authenticated request.
Re-run the YaE Pages stamp for projects/ring/{index,design}.html so they read v0.17.23 instead of v0.17.22.
Add data/scoring.json to the service worker's SHELL precache array alongside seed.json.
Move the judge fav/dis tally to an atomic Postgres UPDATE or explicitly document the accepted KV race.
Log CPU/duration around standTable's cold-path page loop and cap or pre-warm it via cron.
Log CPU/duration around the daily refreshShowCalendar cron parse and lower the per-run detail cap if it trends toward the limit.

deferred.title: Decide a v1.0 freeze vs a scoped Phase-2 milestone (ownership, invites, cert verification).
Revisit pricing/unit-economics; $1/mo needs roughly 500 users to cover hosting.
